rv.q: Director Hayes did a superb job blending reality with the fantastic, delivering a compelling story of love found, lost, and found again.
It’s a love story with an achingly, sometimes painfully slow burn

One can, with some effort, view Jake and Alice as credible characters, thanks to the first-rate performances by Fred Weller and Kate Arrington, as well as a number of realistic exchanges, and some anchoring details...
Jenkin gently and sweetly conjures it up for Shakey Jake.
